tagline: I build AI agents and data pipelines whose results are measured, not promised.
description: Forward Deployed Engineer trainee at Supervity.ai building AI agents and workflow automation, with a data engineering foundation in Microsoft Fabric, PySpark and Delta Lake.

roles.headline: AI & Data Engineer
roles.detailed: AI Agents · LLM Evals · Data Engineering · Microsoft Fabric

bio: Forward Deployed Engineer trainee at Supervity.ai, training on a team that builds AI agents for client workflows and business-operations automation. Previously a Data Engineer Trainee in Insight Enterprises' Data & AI team, building a multi-agent accelerator that turns business requirements into PySpark notebooks and Power BI semantic models on Microsoft Fabric. Focused on AI systems that can be trusted: projects that measure their own fabrication rate, latency and test coverage instead of promising them. B.Tech CSE (Cyber Security), CGPA 8.3; Microsoft certified in AZ-900, DP-900 and DP-700.

bullets: Training as a Forward Deployed Engineer on a team that builds AI agents for client workflows and automates business operations.
Building an accounts-payable invoice-automation demo as a training project: a multi-agent workflow designed from a business requirements document and governed by company policies.
experience.desc: Forward Deployed Engineer trainee on a team that builds AI agents and workflow automation for client business operations.

bullets: Built a multi-agent accelerator (MCP + Microsoft Fabric) that turns business requirements and source data into KPI definitions, PySpark notebooks, and semantic models and reports, published to Fabric through its REST APIs.

Researched Power BI semantic search across multi-tenant workspaces and prototyped a semantic-model advisor (pbixray + FastAPI) that surfaces tables, DAX measures and relationships in an interactive dashboard.
Built an internal résumé-standardisation agent that converts résumés into the company's standard format, and evaluated open-source LLM alternatives to reduce cost and vendor lock-in.
Worked on Medallion-architecture pipelines with Azure Data Factory, PySpark and Delta Lake; earned Microsoft AZ-900, DP-900 and DP-700.
experience.desc: Data & AI team: built agentic accelerators and AI prototypes on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, alongside core data engineering work.

bullets: Contributed to AI applications spanning NLP, computer vision, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector search with Qdrant.
Developed backend APIs, built AI prototypes, and supported model evaluation, prompt engineering and fine-tuning workflows.

Worked on live projects including a notification system on Firebase Cloud Messaging and an AI video-interview system that analysed candidate posture, speech and communication for automated assessment.
experience.desc: Research and development of AI applications across computer vision, NLP, RAG and vector databases, plus backend APIs.

projects.title: Evidence-Grounded Résumé Engine
projects.subtitle: A résumé generator where every claim must cite verified evidence.
projects.desc: RAG plus an NLI verifier gate cut the fabrication rate of kept bullets from 23% to 0% on a hand-labelled golden set (95% upper bound 7%), and blocks all 34 payloads in its prompt-injection suite. Fabrication is measured, not promised.

projects.title: Agentic Pipeline Copilot
projects.subtitle: Plain-English spec in, a validated and tested PySpark notebook out, opened as a pull request.
projects.desc: An LLM agent that generates PySpark from a spec, executes it in a Docker sandbox, tests it and opens a pull request for human review. It never merges its own work. An eval suite gates CI.

projects.title: Real-Time ASL Recognition
projects.subtitle: ASL alphabet recognition on CPU that says "not confident" instead of guessing.
projects.desc: MediaPipe hand crop feeding an INT8-quantised MobileNetV2 in ONNX: 99.96% accuracy, 1.33 ms p50 on CPU, 97× faster than the FP32 Keras model, with a calibrated confidence threshold. Runs in the browser via onnxruntime-web.

projects.title: Metadata-Driven Lakehouse
projects.subtitle: Onboard a new data source with one metadata row, not a new pipeline.
projects.desc: Config-driven ingestion from Bronze to a Gold star schema with data-quality checks, PII masking, OpenLineage lineage and an audit trail. Apache Arrow benchmarked at 16× Spark throughput on 1M rows; 499 tests, 96% coverage.

projects.title: Neighborhood Skill Swap
projects.subtitle: A full-stack skill-swap board with the security most demo apps skip.
projects.metric: Authorization tested on every owned object
projects.desc: React, FastAPI and Postgres with rotating refresh tokens, Argon2id password hashing, rate-limited auth endpoints and authorization tests on every owned resource. Playwright E2E runs in CI.

publications.title: Explainable & Adversarially Robust Fileless Malware Detection
publications.desc: Memory-forensics malware detection using LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, SHAP and Volatility. A soft-voting ensemble reached 100% binary classification accuracy with 73% fewer features, and was validated against adversarial attacks.
